The '''ABP-980 bio-light panel''' was a type of [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] bio-light panel produced by [[Ferisoliq Imports, Ltd.]] It used [[Plankton/Legends|plankton]] to produce light and would dim if there was something effecting the local [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. The device was sold by [[Galladinium Galactic Exports]] for 250 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==Description==
Designed for use in the workplace, the ABP-980 bio-light panel was associated with the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and consisted of a rectangular tank that measured one [[Meter/Legends|meter]] high by two meters long. Inside the tank, photo-chemical reactive [[Plankton/Legends|plankton]], a type of microscopic [[Plant/Legends|plant]], lived in a controlled liquid environment.<ref name="Fantastic Technology" />

These plankton produced light if exposed to a variety of common gases, which included [[Carbon dioxide/Legends|carbon dioxide]], [[Hydrogen/Legends|hydrogen]], and [[Nitrogen/Legends|nitrogen]]. The gas filters in the tank could be controlled by manipulating a recessed stud built into the outer edge of the tank's frame, which allowed the amount of light emitted to be changed. The panel would produce constantly changing patterns of fluid lighting, which was advertised as functional, artistic, and a statement of good taste. Due to the plankton's reaction to chemicals and gases, if a panel dimmed of its own accord, it was a signal that something was wrong with the local [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] supply. This reaction acted as an additional safety feature in the product.<ref name="Fantastic Technology" />

==History==
The light panel was produced by [[Ferisoliq Imports, Ltd.]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] fought by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="Fantastic Technology" /> At some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Fantastic Technology Date">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'' places its own timeframe between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|V}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] respectively.</ref> the technological supply company [[Galladinium Galactic Exports]] sold the panels through its [[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology|product datalog]] for 250 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], describing them as the latest in bioluminescence. The panels were frequently available in large [[City/Legends|cities]] and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]].<ref name="Fantastic Technology" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ABP-980 bio-light panel was mentioned in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', a ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook written by [[Rick D. Stuart]] and released by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]].<ref name="Fantastic Technology" />
